summary: Iter 35 seller-dashboard pagination endpoints + frontend wiring verified. Backend: all 7 paginated endpoints return the correct envelope, respect role auth, honor filters (q/shop_id/stock/low_threshold), embed shop_name/shop_kind or restaurant_name, and return stock_map / unread_count / stats where documented. Frontend: on the seller test account (2 shop products + 2 menu items + 1 shop + 1 restaurant), every affected tab (Products, Wallet & Active Orders, Notifications, Messages, Invoices) fires the correct /paged network call with page=1&page_size=50 and returns 200. Pagination bars are correctly HIDDEN when total <= page_size (verified via testid counts = 0). Search box and stock filter chips on Products tab both propagate q= and stock= params to the server and reset to page 1. Nudge-banner (attrs-nudge-banner) not shown because all current items have populated attributes (correct behavior). No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: pagination_routes.seller_orders_paged builds prod_ids/menu_ids by scanning the seller's ENTIRE product and menu-item collections in memory each request (async for) – for a seller with tens of thousands of SKUs this is O(N) per page load. Consider indexing orders with seller_id embedded at write time, or caching prod_ids per-request.

MAX_PAGE_SIZE=200 is enforced via FastAPI Query(le=200) which returns 422 for over-limit requests instead of silently clamping – docstring/spec says 'clamp to 200'. Behavior is safer (fail-fast) but doesn't match wording; either update the spec or use _clamp inside the handler and drop the le=200 constraint. Currently benign.
Products search regex is escaped with re.escape (good) but not anchored – matches substrings anywhere including category. Fine, just note that querying 'a' will hit almost every product.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for regression scope (all 5 tabs fire correct paged calls; filters work; pagination correctly hidden for small datasets)

seed_data_creation: None. No test data created or left behind.
